# System Information
You are an expert in Java and in analyzing the impact of source code changes on other code entities in a project's production code.

# General Information
You receive information about a set of changes, called seed changes, that were made to fix a bug reported in Jira.
You also receive the Jira bug report title and description and an initial impact set consisting of the fully qualified names of code entities that are statically related to the seed changes.

# Task
Your task is to refine the initial impact set.
A code entity is part of the impact set if it requires modification or, if it does not already exist, must be created as a consequence of the seed changes.
First, remove code entities unless the provided information indicates that they must be modified.
Second, add code entities that must be modified or created according to the provided evidence.

Your goal is to report a final impact set that consists of the fully qualified names of code entities that must be modified or created because of the seed changes.

# Inputs
- Jira bug report title: vfs resolver does not find "latest.integration" using webdav
- Jira bug report description: This is copied from IVY-243 

I am working with SVN HEAD (so kind of ivy 1.4). I am interesting in using a vfs resolver, which I have configured to use webdav.

my resolver tag is the following :

 <ivy pattern="webdav://admin:****@dev-build:85/ivyrep/[organisation]/[module].[revision]/ivy.xml" />
 <artifact pattern="webdav://admin:****@dev-build:85/ivyrep/[organisation]/[module].[revision]/[artifact].[ext]" />
 </vfs>

Xavier already wrote this :

 think the issue you have with vfs is not really related to the problem of SNAPSHOT with maven (which is not a supported feature right now), while what you test should be. Could you please copy paste your report in a new bug? Then maybe you could try also to set alwaysCheckExactRevision to false on your resolver, to avoid the tests on 'latest.integration' as a revision, and get only the log for what the resolver attempt to do to list the revisions. Then maybe using the debug log level could learn us more about what's happening. I have no environment to test webdav myself, so if anybody else can help...

Maarten, I know you've worked on vfs resolver to make it work with webdav. did you have such problems to get a latest revision?
